# The cases of the corpus of du (compare/du/corpus.py); the format: host/recon/casefile.py. src = src/cmd/du.c.

== default
# src: without names: ".", the directories
-- case
step: du

== tree
-- d/a
small
-- d/b

-- d/e/f

-- d/e/g
g
-- d/h/i
i
-- case
step: du d

== all
# src: -a: the files too
-- d/a
small
-- d/b

-- d/e/f

-- d/e/g
g
-- d/h/i
i
-- case
step: du -a d

== sum
# src: -s: only the total
-- d/a
small
-- d/b

-- d/e/f

-- d/e/g
g
-- d/h/i
i
-- case
step: du -s d

== file
# a file as argument without -a: no line (this du prints a file only with -a)
-- f

-- case
step: du f

== file-a
-- f

-- case
step: du -a f

== several
-- f

-- g
x
-- d/x
y
-- case
step: du f g d

== link
# src: a file with more links counts once
-- d/a

-- case
host: ln d/a d/b
step: du -a d

== missing
# src: a missing name: "du: bad status < %s >" only with -r
-- case
step: du nofile

== missing-r
-- case
step: du -r nofile

== bad-option
# src: "usage: du [-ars] [name ...]"
-- case
step: du -x

== options-together
-- d/a
small
-- d/b

-- d/e/f

-- d/e/g
g
-- d/h/i
i
-- case
step: du -as d

== dash
# src: a lone "-" is a name
-- case
step: du -

== unreadable-dir
# a directory without read right for user 100 (the emulator does not model the search right: no message)
-- d/sub/f
x
-- case
host: chmod 311 d/sub
user: 100 100
step: du -r d
host: chmod 755 d/sub

== empty-dir
-- d/keep
-- case
host: rm d/keep
step: du d
